verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Namecheap offers DNS-related capabilities like DNSSEC (secureDNS delegationSigned/zoneSigned), Dynamic DNS via HTTPS updates, and a Terraform provider for managing DNS records programmatically, implying DNS hosting is bundled with domains. However there is no evidence detailing supported record types, TTL granularity, or the quality/usability of the DNS management UI itself, and general community feedback on Namecheap's UX is mixed-to-negative (though not DNS-specific). missing for 10: record-type coverage list, TTL configurability details, direct evidence/review of the DNS management UI's usability.
